name: arkspace
description: Reusable skills for Web evidence, cited research, browser work, monitoring, WeKnora knowledge bases, and GitHub repository analysis.

interface.longDescription: Retrieve Web evidence, produce cited research, operate owned browser sessions, manage monitors, query WeKnora knowledge bases, and analyze GitHub repositories. Shared Provider operations require the separately installed arks CLI and configured credentials or SearXNG instances. Guidance-only workflows use host tools; plugin installation does not install the CLI or configure credentials.
defaultPrompt: Search the web for current sources about this topic.
Fetch these URLs and summarize their contents with citations.
Produce a bounded, cited research report from authoritative sources.
